object_head_relationship: Separate parameters; later heads condition on previously selected objects
memoize_semantics: No replacement within and across pools only while both plan and capped age input are unchanged; reset exclusions on either change
limitations: Fixed Test-4 and 0.5/0.5 tuning, not unbiased generalization or a full-frontier comparison.
Architecture and sampling settings were selected using this test feedback; each checkpoint is the predetermined final training update.
12000 is the per-successful-run candidate limit, not the total tuning compute. The ledger retains all 69 completed runs and one incomplete launch.
Extra critic-hidden-layer models are retained as ablations, not silently promoted.
Training uses only the original 24 large TRAIN instances and each instance's fixed references; no NSGA plans enter learning or search.
Original formal v4 small/large checkpoints, historical NSGA results and formal manuscript remain unchanged.
